Sun-exposure vitamin D estimate for the walk (rough/low-confidence, per the standing sun-exposure method): arms + legs exposed "through most" of the walk — assumed 90% of the 80min duration (~72 min exposed) at a 'moderate' area rate (~30 IU/min, between the small shoulder/neck and large torso+legs anchors). Net estimate: 30 × 72 × 0.55 × 0.5 ≈ 594 IU, rounded to 600 IU. Folded directly into vitamin_d_iu rather than logged as a separate item — flag if any of these assumptions (exposed fraction, area, discounts) should be adjusted.
